assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1).
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9).
CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to correlate these symptoms with potential arrhythmic events.
The denial under CO-22 conflicts with these documented indications.
The service is directly tied to the presenting neuromedical symptoms requiring correlation.
